# Define the task IDs from the progress note
task_ids = [2889, 2897, 2901, 2905, 2908, 2914, 2920, 2922, 3771, 3777, 3784, 3785]

# Fetch comments for each task, using a high page_limit to get all in one go
all_comments = {}
for tid in task_ids:
    # Use page_limit=20 to get all comments (max allowed)
    comments = apis.todoist.show_task_comments(task_id=tid, access_token=access_token, page_limit=20)
    all_comments[tid] = comments
    print(f"Task {tid}: {len(comments)} comments")
    for c in comments:
        print(f"  Comment by {c['user']['name']} ({c['user']['email']}): {c['content']}")
